logMd:
### Round 1 - Track T2 (Skill registries and directories)

**Date:** 2026-08-26. **Method:** live enumeration of skill registries, npm keyword search via registry.npmjs.org API (skillpm's JSON API is auth-gated; its source index is the npm `agent-skill` keyword, so the npm API is the same corpus), 6 WebSearch queries, and repo-level verification of every recorded candidate via GitHub page fetches. gh CLI not used (broken in this environment). 4 sparing api.github.com calls confirmed the implausible-looking star counts (gstack 129.8k, ui-ux-pro-max 121.2k, taste-skill 80.9k, impeccable 62.8k) are real.

**Platforms searched:** skills.sh (leaderboard, /topic/design, /trending, /packs), agentskills.io (+llms.txt - has NO skill directory, only spec + client showcase), skillpm.dev/registry (911 skills) via npm API (keywords: design, ux, accessibility, design-system), mcpservers.org/agent-skills, officialskills.sh (649 skills/54 vendor teams), skillselion.com (llms.txt; skill pages JS-rendered), agenticskills.io/category/design (11 entries), awesome-copilot.github.com/skills (414 skills, ~5 design), skillsllm.com, buildwithclaude.com (403), lobehub market (403), plus catalog repos VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills, sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills (2,028 skills), tech-leads-club/agent-skills.

**Candidates:** 30 recorded across visual-design (anthropics frontend-design/canvas-design, leonxlnx taste-skill, sheleg), design-qa (impeccable, anti-ui-slop, vercel web-design-guidelines, microsoft frontend-design-review, web-app-ux-auditor), design-systems (ui-ux-pro-max, extract-design-system, southleft figma-console skills, plugin87 ux-ui-agent-skills, dopod-design/Carbon, theme-factory), design-engineering (emilkowalski skills, stitch-skills, figma/mcp-server-guide, openai figma-implement-design, composition-patterns), accessibility (addyosmani web-quality-skills, ymrl a11y-check-skills, ehmo platform-design-skills), research (laws-of-ux), content-design (ux-araby - Arabic microcopy), orchestration/strategy (garrytan gstack design suite, uxcraft, product-design-ceo-orchestrator), interaction-design (sleek design-mobile-apps, platform-design-skills).

**Notable structure findings:** the highest-install design skills concentrate in ~10 repos that skills.sh surfaces; npm keyword corpus adds a long tail of small single-author skills (many <5 stars, npm-distributed); vendor-official design skills (Figma, Google Labs Stitch, Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic) are indexed by officialskills.sh. agentskills.io deliberately hosts no directory. Two entries are recorded with npm-only verification (sheleg-design-skill, dopod-design) - flagged in notes.

**Could not verify/access:** buildwithclaude.com/skills (403), lobehub market page (403 after redirect), skills.sh/packs (sign-in), skillselion skill listings (JS-rendered; llms.txt gave the /design hub map instead), skillpm JSON API (auth). figma/mcp-server-guide license not visible. openai/skills is deprecated (successor openai/plugins unexplored).

**New queries generated for round 2:** enumerate skillselion.com/design's 9 sub-niche pages; openagentskill.com; openai/plugins; sickn33 'Product Design Studio' and 'Accessibility & Inclusive UX' bundle members; ckw-design-skill (connerkward); WordPress/wpds; the ~11 unverified npm finds (stylegraft, apple-design-principles, ui-architect-skill, vibe-ui-skill, oh-my-design, vyre-skill, bisit, overhaul-ui, motionloom, apple-hig-skill, mobile-app-ux-auditor); npm keywords not yet queried: figma, frontend, motion, wcag, ui, prototype, research; lobehub market via alternate path; officialskills.sh figma + flutter series pages.
